cells.announcement: June 2, 2026 End-of-Life (EoL) announcement - Customers on WHD version 12.8 should begin transitioning to the latest version of WHD.
cells.eoe: July 4, 2026 End-of-Engineering (EoE) - Service releases, bug fixes, workarounds, and service packs for WHD version 12.8 will no longer actively be supported by SolarWinds.
cells.eol: November 30, 2026 End-of-Life (EoL) - SolarWinds will no longer provide technical support for WHD version 12.8  or earlier.
